profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer  at XPAND Corporation
profile.summary:
•	Experience in Designing and Developing MVC3, ASP.Net,XSLT,HTML, XML, CSS,   JavaScript,Jquery.
•	Experienced Software Configuration Manager ( SCM)
•	Experience and Extensive Knowledge on VEVRA and OFCCP Section 503 regulations.
•	Experienced Scrum Master ( SCM certified, Agile, Waterfall, Kanban, Lean Scrum).
•	Extensive Experience with SDL TRIDION Web Content Management (WCM) Architecture and Development.
•	Experience in Developing and Building Work Flows and Integrating Intelligent Custom web Forms using SKELTA Business Project Management (BPM) product and .Net Workflow Engine.
•	Experience on Computer Filing Cabinet system (CFC), Content Management System (CMS) and Document Image Management (DIM).
•	Knowledge of Creating and Developing Custom Activities, SOA within BPM.Net
•	Experience and Knowledge on FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and HIPAA, FIPS compliant system validations.
•	Experience and involved in every phase of Project Development Cycle and SDLC
•	Experience in complex programming techniques like multi threading, Inheritance, polymorphism and Encapsulation.
•	Experience using third party products like Infragistics, EMC products like PixTran, PixTools, and LlblGenPro Entity Framework.
•	Experience in developing data driven applications and Knowledge on Design patterns.
•	Experience in Database Programming (Stored procedures, Triggers, Views, Cursors, T-SQL, CTE) using SQL Server 2005/2008.
•	Experience using MSTEST and NUNIT Unit Testing frameworks as a part of project development cycle.
•	Experience working with database objects: Creating tables, indexes, constraints, views, stored procedures, functions, cursors and triggers and worked with several types of Queries/Macros in MS Access. 
•	Experience in documenting Training manuals and Knowledge Transfer manuals.
•	Experience of performing Performance Tuning (Hints, Indexes, Partitioning of tables) in SQL SERVER.
•	Ability to handle multiple projects at a time.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Experience in converting legacy applications to .Net framework.
* Experience with 3-tier architecture for presentation layer, the Business and Data Access Layers.
* Developed application with 3rd party Infragistics web controls.
* Responsible for converting application’s data layer to entity/domain framework.
* Experience working with collaborative bug, defect and issue tracking system (On-time) and CVS like Source Gear Vault Pro.
* Solved multiple cross browser compatibility issues.
